definitions.explanation: The hard, woody fruit of a pine tree, with overlapping scales that open to release seeds. A common natural object found on the ground in pine forests.

examples.japanese: ⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{松|まつ}ぼっくり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{拾|ひろ}った→拾う：00845_hirou⟧。
examples.english: I picked up a pine cone in the park.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{松|まつ}ぼっくり⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{工作|こうさく}→工作：12437_kousaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The children did craft projects using pine cones.

examples.japanese: ⟦{湿気|しっけ}→湿気：03177_shikke⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{松|まつ}ぼっくり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{傘|かさ}→傘：00639_kasa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{閉|と}じ→閉じる：02303_tojiru⟧、⟦{乾|かわ}く→乾く：00786_kawaku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦また→また：00969_mata⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: When it's humid, the scales of a pine cone close; they open again when it dries out.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{松|まつ}→松：02256_matsu⟧ (pine) + ぼっくり (an older word related to a small round/lumpy shape). The kanji form {松毬|まつぼっくり} exists but the kana form is standard.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {松|まつ}ぼっくり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{拾|ひろ}う→拾う：00845_hirou⟧: to pick up pine cones
- {松|まつ}ぼっくり⟦{工作|こうさく}→工作：12437_kousaku⟧: pine-cone crafts (a popular kids' activity)
- {松|まつ}ぼっくり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{傘|かさ}→傘：00639_kasa⟧: the scales ("umbrella") of a pine cone
- ⟦クリスマス→クリスマス：03839_kurisumasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{松|まつ}ぼっくり: pine cones for Christmas decorations

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {松|まつ}かさ: another word for pine cone — slightly more formal/literary
- どんぐり: acorn — a different tree's nut, but in a similar "natural object you pick up outside" category
